entries.question: How does Arbitrix work?
entries.answer: Arbitrix is an automated arbitrage platform, designed to seek arbitrage opportunities automatically across supported markets. It places trades for you, so you do not have to trade by hand. You can try it first in Demo Mode with virtual funds, then move to Live Mode with real funds when you are ready. Results vary - you can gain or lose.
entries.source: public/index.html landing ('Automated Arbitrage. Made Simple.'); server.js trading routes

entries.question: What is arbitrage?
entries.answer: Arbitrage means taking advantage of a price difference for the same asset between markets - buying where it is cheaper and selling where it is more expensive. Arbitrix automates that process for you.

entries.question: Can I use Demo Mode?
entries.answer: Yes. Demo Mode lets you try Arbitrix with virtual funds so you can see how it works without using real money. A new Demo account starts with $1,000 in virtual funds. Demo funds are not real and cannot be withdrawn.

entries.question: Does Demo Mode use real money?
entries.answer: No. Demo Mode uses virtual funds only - a new Demo account starts with $1,000 that is not real money. Nothing in Demo Mode can be withdrawn.

entries.question: How do I start Demo Mode?
entries.answer: Open the app and switch to DEMO using the DEMO / LIVE switch at the top. You can then start the bot and watch it work with virtual funds.

entries.question: How does Live Mode work?
entries.answer: In Live Mode Arbitrix trades with real funds in your Live balance. You fund your Live balance with a deposit (minimum $100) and then start the bot to trade automatically. Live results are real and can go up or down - you can lose money.
entries.source: server.js:489 minimum deposit; public/index.html live mode copy

entries.question: How do I switch between Demo and Live?
entries.answer: Use the DEMO / LIVE switch at the top of the app. Demo uses virtual funds; Live uses the real funds in your Live balance.

entries.question: How do I get started?
entries.answer: 1) Create your account. 2) Explore Demo Mode with virtual funds. 3) When you are ready, switch to Live and make a deposit of at least $100. 4) Start the bot and follow your results in the dashboard. If any step is unclear, our support team can help.

entries.question: What is the minimum deposit?
entries.answer: The minimum deposit is $100. Deposits are credited to your Live balance.

entries.question: How do I make a deposit?
entries.answer: Switch to Live Mode, open Deposit, enter an amount of at least $100, then send the exact amount of USDT on the TRON (TRC20) network to the address shown. Deposits are detected automatically once the network confirms them.
entries.source: public/index.html deposit modal; server.js deposit routes

entries.question: Which cryptocurrency can I deposit?
entries.answer: Deposits are made in USDT on the TRON (TRC20) network. Before sending, make sure your wallet or exchange supports USDT on TRC20, and always check the address and network shown on the Deposit screen.
entries.source: public/index.html deposit modal ('USDT on TRON (TRC20) only')

entries.question: My deposit is still pending
entries.answer: TRC20 deposits are detected automatically and normally confirm within a few minutes. Keep your invoice reference and never send the same payment twice. If it still has not appeared, our support team can check it using your transaction hash.

entries.question: My payment failed or expired
entries.answer: An expired invoice is never credited. Create a new invoice and pay the exact amount shown, on TRON (TRC20). If funds already left your wallet, contact support with the transaction hash - and never send the same payment twice.

entries.question: How does the bot work?
entries.answer: The bot is designed to seek arbitrage opportunities automatically across supported markets, and places trades using the platform strategy. You start and stop it from the dashboard, and every trade is recorded in your history. Results vary and are not guaranteed.

entries.question: Does the bot keep trading if I close the app?
entries.answer: Yes for Live Mode. Live bots run on our servers, so trading continues even if you close the app, log out, or your phone goes to sleep - your trade history updates as trades are recorded. Demo Mode runs in your browser, so a Demo bot stops when you close the app.
entries.source: production verified: TRADING_WORKER_ENABLED=true on Render with observed trade_recorded events (services/TradingWorker.js + migrations 028/029). Demo Mode is browser-side only.

entries.question: Is trading risky?
entries.answer: Yes. Trading involves risk and results vary - you can lose money as well as gain. Arbitrix does not promise profits or guaranteed returns, and nothing here is financial advice.

entries.question: How do withdrawals work?
entries.answer: To withdraw from Live you normally need a qualifying first deposit, at least one completed trade, and a valid wallet address. There is no minimum withdrawal amount. Genuinely earned referral rewards are an exception - they can be withdrawn without placing a trade. A withdrawal starts as pending and appears in your history.

entries.question: What is the minimum withdrawal?
entries.answer: No minimum withdrawal is needed - there is no minimum withdrawal amount, and you can withdraw any amount up to your available balance.
entries.source: management decision (no minimum). NOTE: server.js MIN_WITHDRAWAL_USD = 500 still enforces a production minimum until the withdrawal code is aligned.

entries.question: How long does a withdrawal take?
entries.answer: Withdrawals usually arrive within 15-30 minutes after you place the request. You can follow the status in your transaction history, and if it takes longer than that, contact support and we will check it for you.
entries.source: management decision (15-30 minutes). NOTE: server.js has no processing timer yet - production withdrawals stay 'pending' until processing is implemented.

entries.question: My withdrawal is stuck or has not arrived
entries.answer: I am not able to check your account from here. Please contact support with the amount, the destination address and the date, and our team will investigate. Never share your password, private key or seed phrase with anyone.

entries.question: Do I need to verify my identity?
entries.answer: No. Arbitrix does not require identity verification (KYC) - you can deposit, trade and withdraw without submitting identity documents.
entries.source: management decision (no KYC); server.js WITHDRAWAL_REQUIRES_VERIFICATION default false and MARKETING_SANDBOX has no KYC

entries.question: What documents do I need for verification?
entries.answer: You do not need to submit any documents. Identity verification is not required on Arbitrix.

entries.question: How do I keep my account safe?
entries.answer: Never share your password, private key, seed phrase, or one-time codes with anyone - Arbitrix support will never ask you for them. Always use official channels and check the address and network before you send funds.

entries.question: What is the $50 promotional credit?
entries.answer: New Live accounts may receive a $50 promotional credit in the Live balance. It is a head start you can trade with - it is not a deposit and it cannot be withdrawn. To withdraw funds you need a qualifying deposit (at least $100) and at least one completed trade.

entries.question: Why did my bot stop after making a profit?
entries.answer: While you are trading only the $50 promotional credit (before your first qualifying deposit), realized profit from it is capped at $20. When the cap is reached the bot stops and further trading needs a qualifying deposit. After you deposit, that cap no longer applies.

entries.question: What is the referral program?
entries.answer: You earn 20% of the first qualifying deposit of each person you refer - a one-time reward. Their deposit must reach the minimum qualifying amount ($100) for the reward to count. There is no recurring commission.

entries.question: How do I use my referral earnings?
entries.answer: Referral rewards are credited to your Bonus Wallet. You can convert them to your Live balance at any time - there is no minimum to convert - and genuinely earned referral rewards can be withdrawn without needing to place a trade.

entries.question: How much is the subscription?
entries.answer: Arbitrix Pro is $7 per month. It is deducted from your available Live balance when due, and no card is required. If your balance is too low when it is due, the subscription is marked as due and retried - it does not create a debt.

entries.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
entries.answer: Yes - you can cancel from the Subscription section in your profile. You keep access until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again after cancelling.

entries.question: Do I get 14 days free?
entries.answer: I cannot confirm that accurately from here and I do not want to give you the wrong information. Please contact support and we will confirm the current plan and any free period that applies to your account.
entries.source: conflict: marketing copy claims 14 free days; no 14-day logic in server.js

entries.question: Which countries can use Arbitrix?
entries.answer: I do not have a verified list of supported countries here, so I do not want to guess. Arbitrix is used through the web app and deposits are made in USDT (TRC20). Please contact support and we will confirm this for your country.
entries.source: no country-restriction logic found in the repository

entries.question: What payment methods are supported?
entries.answer: Deposits are made with USDT on the TRON (TRC20) network. No card or bank details are needed. Always confirm the exact asset and network on the Deposit screen before sending.
entries.source: public/index.html deposit modal; server.js deposit routes

entries.question: I cannot log in
entries.answer: I cannot access account details from here. Please use 'Forgot password' on the login screen, and if you still cannot get in, contact support - we will help you regain access securely. Never share your password with anyone.

entries.question: The bot is not starting
entries.answer: Check that you are in the mode you want (Demo or Live) and, if you are in Live, that your Live balance is funded. If it still will not start, contact support with a screenshot and we will look into it.

entries.question: I sent funds to the wrong address or network
entries.answer: Please contact support right away with the transaction hash. Sending on the wrong network can result in loss of funds, and our team will help you check what can be done.

entries.question: How do I contact a human?
entries.answer: You can ask for a human at any time - just say so, or use /escalate in this chat. Support can help with payment disputes, deposits or withdrawals that look wrong, account access problems, and anything I am not sure about.

entries.question: Will I make a profit?
entries.answer: No one can promise that. Arbitrix does not guarantee profits or returns and trading involves risk - you can lose money as well as gain. Past results do not predict future results. This is general information, not financial advice.

entries.question: Should I invest or deposit more?
entries.answer: I cannot give personalized financial or trading advice and I will not tell you how much to invest. I can explain how Arbitrix works so you can decide what is right for you. For anything specific to your situation, please speak with our support team.
